Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; SUBSIDIES FOR FEDERALLY QUALIFIED HEALTH CENTERS. +]

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to health; appropriating money for subsidies to federally qualified health centers.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; SUBSIDIES FOR FEDERALLY QUALIFIED HEALTH CENTERS.

$2,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $2,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for subsidies to federally qualified health centers according to Minnesota Statutes, section 145.9269.
additions: APPROPRIATION; SUBSIDIES FOR FEDERALLY QUALIFIED HEALTH CENTERS.

$2,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $2,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for subsidies to federally qualified health centers according to Minnesota Statutes, section 145.9269.
